name: dumbbell lying single straight arm press on floor
description: A one-arm press from the floor with a straight arm that trains the chest and shoulder stabilisers.
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and one dumbbell held above your chest.
Keep the other arm resting on the floor beside you.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight and the shoulder reaches forward.
Lower it back with control until your upper arm touches the floor.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.
